source: Traced in the map's metres (cityctx: x east, y north) from the Tokyo Digital Twin Project's 23-ward orthophoto, FY2023 survey, sheets 09LD2659 and 09LD2669 at 0.20 m a pixel (CC BY 4.0: 「東京都デジタルツイン実現プロジェクト 区部点群データ」（東京都）を加工して作成), with tools/ortho_overlay.py. To within half a metre.
note: The bus stand in front of Hachiko, inside Jingu-dori's one-way loop (OpenStreetMap 1033129758 and 1380679907, the stops local_ref 0 and 21). The photo has no raised island there: one asphalt plain, as PLATEAU surveys it, laid out in paint. A U of solid line round where the buses stand, closed by a diagonal line to the south-west, a dotted lane edge along the south-bound lane, and a hatched wedge where the U meets the north-bound lane. The painted legend is left out.
